description: Use to create a new bridge deck (beam grillage or plate mesh) from spans, widths and skew. To change a deck already in the model use bridge_reshape; for geometry from a drawing use dxf_import. Generates a bridge deck (beam grillage or plate mesh) with the Skew Grillage Geometry Generator plugin's own engine: skew (0 = straight/square), unequal girders, plan curvature, multi-span, crossfall and vertical profile, arch grillages (circular, parabolic or elliptical, given rise), slab depth, automatic transverse section sizing and structure groups (GIRDERS, CROSS-BEAMS, END-BEAMS for the support-line members, SPAN-n, or DECK for plates). A deck can be placed by a base point and added into a model that already has a structure (addToExisting). Without apply it only previews (counts, metrics, groups, planHash). With apply: true it writes to CIVIL NX exactly as the plugin does: it refuses a model that already holds geometry unless addToExisting or replaceExisting is set, creates default material/sections/thickness where the ids are missing, and records the run for skew_grillage_undo.

addToExisting.description: Put the deck into a model that already holds geometry (the plugin's 'Add into the existing model', which it asks the user to confirm — ask the user too). Nothing is deleted: node and element ids continue past the model's highest, nodes within 1 mm of existing ones are joined, members already in the model are left out, automatic transverse sections move to free ids and taken group names get -2, -3. The preview reads the model and shows exactly that.

allowDefaultProperties.description: Create a default C30-like material and rectangular sections/thickness when the ids are not in the model.

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview.

autoTransverseSections.description: One transverse section per measured tributary width (beam decks).

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; the write is refused if the plan differs.

connectNodes.description: addToExisting: join grillage nodes that fall within 1 mm of existing nodes (false = always new nodes).

geometry.description: Deck inputs, named as in the plugin. Anything omitted takes the plugin form's default. Lengths in metres, angles in degrees.

archEnabled.description: Arch grillage: each girder follows an arch profile between its own bearing lines (one arch per span when multi-span). Crossfall and vertical profile are switched off while it is on.

archEqualArc.description: true (default): cross beams at equal spacing measured ROUND the arch (count = arc length / transverseSpacing); false: equal spacing in plan.

archRise.description: Rise f from springing to crown, m (default 4).

archShape.description: Arch profile. Circular needs rise ≤ span/2.

deckWidth.description: Width between the OUTER GIRDER LINES, m (default 10), not the deck width: the girders are spread across it, the outer ones on its edges. For a deck that overhangs its outer girders use girderSpacings with the overhangs first and last (edge lines at the deck edges, to be given a dummy section).

elementType.description: beam = grillage of girders and cross beams; plate = plate-mesh deck.

endSkewAngle.description: Skew of the end support if different (a trapezium deck).

girderSpacings.description: Girder spacings, m, one per bay (lines − 1); sets the line count and deckWidth (their sum). 4 girders at 2.5 m = [2.5, 2.5, 2.5]; the same with 1.25 m deck overhangs = [1.25, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 1.25] (the outer two lines are the deck edges: give them a dummy section afterwards).

levelsEnabled.description: Turn on crossfall and vertical profile.

orientation.description: Cross beams parallel to the supports, or square to the girders.

plateThickness.description: Older name for slabDepth (used only when slabDepth is not given).

skewAngle.description: Skew of the start support from square, degrees (±60).

slabDepth.description: Slab depth, m (default 0.25): the depth of every automatic transverse beam section and the plate thickness of a plate deck.

supports.description: Multi-span: one row per support line (spans + 1): skew, joint gap a, bearing offset b.

transverseSpacing.description: Cross-beam (or plate) spacing along the span.

placement.description: Base point move (like AutoCAD COPY): a point on the grillage and the model coordinate it goes to. The grillage is rotated in plan about the base point, then moved. Use with addToExisting to put a deck against a structure already in the model.

baseNodeId.description: basePoint node: the grillage node number, as numbered in this tool's preview before the move.

basePoint.description: The grillage's base point: the deck origin, the first/middle/last girder at the start or end support line, or a grillage node (baseNodeId). Default start-mid.

rotation.description: Plan rotation about the base point, degrees anticlockwise (default 0).

target.description: Model coordinate (m) the base point goes to.

targetNodeId.description: Take the target coordinate from this node of the open model instead of target.

replaceExisting.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete all nodes, elements, sections, thicknesses, materials and structure groups first. Only with the user's explicit agreement.

name: skew_grillage
title: Skew Grillage Geometry Generator
